story.title: 30+ years of Colombian flavor in Jackson Heights.
story.body: La Nueva Delicia has served Colombian food in the heart of Queens for more than three decades. Our roots are in Caldas, in Colombia's coffee region, and you can taste them in every dish: home-style recipes, fresh ingredients, everything cooked just right. Our team serves with warmth, because what matters most to us is that everyone who walks in feels at home.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: This page explains in plain words what data this site collects.
privacy.analytics: We use Google Analytics (GA4) to measure, anonymously, how the site is used: which pages are visited and which buttons are tapped. We do not store your name or personal details.
privacy.why: Only to improve the site so the menu, hours and directions are easy to find.
privacy.ads: This site shows no ads and does no remarketing.
